name: Dembow
description: Tempo-synced reggaeton dembow kit. Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat. Kick/cha spine carries the dembow feel; X grows rim answers, Y adds percussion and fill. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill.

params.name: RIM
params.detail: Rim / cha answer density between main hits

params.name: PERC
params.detail: Hat / percussion density and fill energy
